DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 本日はどのようなお手続きですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: What procedure would you like help with today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自分の口座について相談したいです。家にあった父の印鑑を持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自分の口座へ父の印鑑を持参したと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to ask about my own account. I brought my father's seal from home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you brought your father's seal for a matter concerning your own account. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご自身のお届け印として登録している物ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is it registered as the seal for your own account?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりません。銀行には印鑑ならどれでもよいと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 印鑑の登録状況が不明だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I do not know. I thought any seal would do at a bank.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you do not know whether the seal is registered. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 登録状況を確認します。お父様の物を使うことについて、ご本人の了承はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check the registration status. Do you have your father's permission to use his seal?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありません。勝手に使わず、今日は必要な物を教えてもらうだけにできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 了承なく使わず持ち物の案内だけを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: No. Could I avoid using it without permission and just find out what I need to bring today?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not use it without permission; ask only for information about what to bring. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。ご本人確認の後、今回の手続きに必要な物をご案内します。こちらに押印しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. After verifying your identity, we will explain what you need for this procedure. Please do not stamp this.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだ押していません。父の印鑑はしまい、口座の資料だけ出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 押印前で家族の印鑑をしまうと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have not stamped it yet. I will put my father's seal away and take out only the documents about my account.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you have not stamped anything and will put away your family member's seal. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。登録状況を確認できない部分は、別の担当へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Thank you. We will refer any registration details we cannot confirm to another staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。今日は案内を確認し、必要な物がそろってから改めて手続きをします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 案内を受け準備後に手続きすると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. Today I will check the instructions and come back to complete the procedure once I have everything necessary.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will receive the instructions and complete the procedure after preparing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ではご相談の口座資料を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let us check the documents for the account you want to discuss.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 小さい袋は安く、大きい袋は割引です。どちらがお得か、札の数字だけでは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 容量が違う二商品の比較方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The small pouch is inexpensive, and the large pouch is discounted. I cannot tell which is better value from the numbers on the tags alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to compare two products of different volumes. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 量が違うので、同じ量あたりの価格を比べると分かりやすいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Since the quantities differ, comparing the price for the same amount makes it easier to tell.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 小さい袋は百ミリリットルあたりとあります。大きい方も同じ単位の札ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 価格表示の単位が共通か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The small pouch says per one hundred milliliters. Does the large one have a tag using the same unit?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check whether the price labels use the same unit. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらも百ミリリットルあたりです。ただ、香りが違いますが大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: This one is also per one hundred milliliters. However, the fragrance is different. Is that all right?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 香りまで同じと思っていました。いつもの香りが必要なので、その種類で比較したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 香りの希望を伝え比較対象を絞る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I thought the fragrance was the same too. I need my usual fragrance, so I would like to compare that variety.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State your preferred fragrance and narrow down the products to compare. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ではこの二つです。容量と単価はこちらにあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then these are the two. Their volumes and unit prices are here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 単価は大きい方が低いですね。でも置き場所が狭いので、袋の幅も見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 単価と保管幅の両方を検討すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: The unit price of the larger one is lower. But my storage space is narrow, so I will also check the pouch width.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will consider both the unit price and the width needed for storage. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 無理なく保管できる量をお選びください。開けずに外側の寸法は確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please choose an amount you can comfortably store. You can check the outside dimensions without opening the package.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 小さい袋にします。単価だけでなく、香りと置ける量を確認して選びました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 価格以外の条件も踏まえ購入を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take the small pouch. I chose it after checking not only the unit price but also the fragrance and how much I can store.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide on a purchase considering factors other than price as well. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらですね。詰替え先の製品との組合せも表示でご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: This one, correct? Please also check the label to make sure it is compatible with the product you will refill.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらで何をされる予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: What are you planning to do here?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 笛の練習です。人の少ない場所なら続けて吹いてもよいと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 笛の練習をしたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Practice the flute. I thought I could keep playing in a place with few people.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to practice the flute. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 音が離れた場所まで届くこともあります。使用条件を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Sound can sometimes reach places far away. Let us check the rules for using this area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 短い曲を繰り返します。周りから苦情が来てから止めればよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 苦情後の中止でよいか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will play a short piece repeatedly. Would it be all right to stop only if someone nearby complains?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check whether stopping after a complaint is acceptable. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 先に確認してください。この区域では楽器の練習をご遠慮いただいています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check beforehand. We ask people not to practice musical instruments in this area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。音を出さず指使いだけ確認することはできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 音を出さない指使いの確認を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. May I check just the fingering without making any sound?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about practicing fingering without making a sound. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ほかの方の通行を妨げず、通常の休憩の範囲なら可能です。長時間場所を占有するのは避けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: That is possible as part of an ordinary rest, provided you do not obstruct anyone passing. Please avoid occupying the space for a long time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ベンチに荷物を広げず、少し確認したら移動します。音を出す練習は別の場所を探します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 占有せず別の練習場所を探すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not spread my belongings over the bench, and I will move on after checking briefly. I will look for another place to practice with sound.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will not occupy the space and will look for another practice location. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 施設の練習室など、目的に合う場所の利用条件をお調べください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please look into the conditions for using a suitable place, such as a practice room at a facility.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。ここでは吹かず、練習できる施設を探してから予約を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 園内で吹かず施設の条件を調べると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will not play here. I will look for a facility where I can practice and then check how to reserve it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will not play in the park and will check facility rules. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご理解ありがとうございます。通路には荷物を置かないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12231-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for understanding. Please do not leave belongings on the path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どちらまでの券をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: What destination is your ticket for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 目的地までの券ですが、家から連絡があり、ここで降りて戻りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 途中で目的地行きをやめ帰りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is for my destination, but I received a message from home, and I would like to get off here and go back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to stop traveling toward your destination partway and return home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この駅で旅程を終えるご相談ですね。お使いの券を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: You would like to end your journey at this station, then. Let me check your ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。残った区間を帰りの券としてそのまま使えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未使用区間を帰りに使えるか質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. Can I just use the unused section as my return ticket?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can use the unused section for the return journey. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのまま帰りに使えるとは限りません。券の種類と使用済み区間を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: You cannot necessarily use it for the return journey as it is. We will check the ticket type and the section already used.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。まだ改札を通していません。行きを終える処理と帰りの購入を別々に教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現在券の処理と帰り購入を分けて尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I have not put it through the ticket gate yet. Please explain separately how to end the outward trip and how to buy a return ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask separately about handling your current ticket and buying a return ticket. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: まずこちらで現在の券を確認します。帰りはご自宅側のどの駅へ向かいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: First, we will check your current ticket here. Which station toward home will you return to?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 出発した駅です。払戻しがあるかだけでなく、戻るために必要な券を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 帰着駅と必要な案内を明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: The station I departed from. Besides whether there is a refund, I would like to know what ticket I need to get back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Specify the station you are returning to and the information you need. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 条件を調べてご説明します。確認前に券を捨てないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check the conditions and explain them. Please do not throw away the ticket before we check it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。今の券を渡し、説明を聞いてから帰りの券を用意します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 券を保持し条件説明後に準備すると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will give you my current ticket and get a return ticket ready after hearing the explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will keep the ticket and prepare after the conditions are explained. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お預かりします。行きの使用状況から確認しますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will take it. Let us start by checking how it has been used for the outward journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 番号札をこちらで取ってお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please take a numbered ticket here and wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 急いで買い物を済ませたいので、友人に札を渡して呼ばれたら説明してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 外出中に友人へ番号札を預けたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to finish some shopping quickly, so I will give the ticket to my friend and have them explain when my number is called.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to leave the numbered ticket with your friend while you go out. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 呼ばれた時にご本人が不在だと、そのまま手続きできない場合があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: If you are absent when your number is called, we may not be able to proceed with the procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 友人は用件を知らないので、席を取ってもらうだけのつもりでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人は代理申請でなく留守番だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: My friend does not know what I need to do, so I only meant to have them hold my place.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your friend is only waiting for you, not applying on your behalf. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 札を持つ方が申請者の代わりになるわけではありません。離席する時間はどのくらいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person holding the ticket does not thereby become the applicant's representative. How long would you be away?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 三十分ほどです。戻るまで番号を止めておいてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 外出時間を伝え順番保留を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: About thirty minutes. Could you put my number on hold until I return?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the time you will be away and ask whether your turn can be held. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 個別に順番を止めることはできません。戻った時の案内をこちらで確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We cannot hold individual places in the queue. Please check with us about what to do when you return.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: それなら今は買い物をやめて待ちます。友人も自分の用事へ行って大丈夫ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 外出を取りやめ本人で待つと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: In that case, I will leave the shopping for now and wait. My friend can go take care of their own errands, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide not to go out and to wait yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。お客様ご自身が札を持ってお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please hold the ticket and wait yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。札を友人へ預けず、呼ばれたら自分で用件を説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 番号札と用件説明を自分で担うと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will not leave the ticket with my friend and will explain my request myself when called.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will keep your own ticket and explain your request yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お番号はこちらです。呼出しを確認してお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is your number. Please wait and listen for it to be called.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: これから検査の説明をします。音が聞こえたらボタンを押してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: I will explain the test now. Please press the button when you hear a sound.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 右の耳は聞こえにくいです。少しでも何か聞こえたと思ったら押してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 左右差と反応方法の疑問を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have difficulty hearing in my right ear. Should I press it if I think I hear even a slight sound?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the difference between your ears and your question about how to respond. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 反応の方法は検査担当が説明します。聞こえ方の違いを先に伝えておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: The testing staff member will explain how to respond. Let us tell them about the difference in your hearing first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 左は聞こえますが、右は音なのか周りの音なのか迷います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 右耳で判断に迷う状況を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can hear with my left ear, but with my right I am unsure whether it is the test sound or noise around me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the difficulty deciding what you hear with your right ear. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 分かりました。担当がどのように区別するか説明します。普段使っている補助の機器はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. The staff member will explain how to distinguish them. Do you normally use any hearing assistance device?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 補聴器があります。検査の前に外す必要があるか、指示を聞いてから動かしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 補聴器を外す前に指示を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have a hearing aid. Before moving it, I would like to hear the instructions about whether I need to remove it for the test.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the instructions before removing your hearing aid. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当へ確認します。外した場合に保管するケースはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check with the staff member. Have you brought a case to store it in if you remove it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、あります。説明を聞き直せるよう、検査を始める前に合図も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 保管ケースと説明を求める合図を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, I have. Please also tell me a signal to use before the test starts if I need the explanation repeated.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Discuss the storage case and a signal for asking for an explanation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 不明な時は手を挙げて開始前にお知らせください。担当を呼びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: If something is unclear, please raise your hand and tell us before the test starts. I will call the staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。右の聞こえ方と補聴器の扱いを確認してから検査を受けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 担当説明後に検査へ進むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will take the test after confirming my right ear's hearing and how to handle my hearing aid.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will proceed with the test after the staff member's explanation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へ伝えました。ここで説明をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have informed the staff member. Please wait here for the explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご相談はこの席で伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: We will hear your concerns at this seat.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 遠くの友人にも聞いてもらいたいので、通話をつないだまま話してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 遠くの友人を通話で参加させたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like a friend far away to listen too. May I talk with a phone call connected?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to have a distant friend participate by phone. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今、相手にこちらの声が聞こえていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can the other person hear us right now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだつないでいません。自分の相談なら自由に配信できると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通話前で配信していないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not connected the call yet. I thought I could freely broadcast it if it was my own consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that the call has not started and you are not broadcasting. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ほかの方の情報もあります。通話を始める前に、参加させたい理由を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: There is also information about other people. Before starting a call, let me ask why you want your friend to participate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私が聞き漏らした内容を覚えていてもらいたいです。通訳ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通訳以外の参加理由を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like them to remember things I might miss. They are not an interpreter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain a reason for participation other than interpretation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: まず、ご自身のメモで確認しながら進められます。分からない点はその場で聞き返してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: For now, we can proceed while you check your own notes. Please ask again on the spot about anything you do not understand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: それで進めます。友人に後で話す時は、他人の情報を含めず自分の相談内容だけにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: メモで進め後の共有範囲に配慮すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will do that. When I talk to my friend later, I will share only my own consultation details, without other people's information.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will proceed using notes and be careful about what you share later. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 共有してよい範囲についても、必要なら確認してください。今日は通話なしでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also ask what you may share if necessary. Is it all right to proceed without a phone call today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、つながずに相談します。メモを取り、最後に自分の理解を確認させてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通話なしで最後に理解確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, I will discuss it without connecting a call. Please let me take notes and check my understanding at the end.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask to proceed without a phone call and check your understanding at the end. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。確認の時間を取りながら伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We will set aside time to check as we listen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 郵便物のお問い合わせに使う控えはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a receipt or record we can use for your mail inquiry?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: このレシートです。切手を買った日に手紙も出したので、これで差出しが分かりますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 切手レシートを差出し控えとして提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: This receipt. I posted the letter on the day I bought the stamps, so this shows that I sent it, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Present a stamp purchase receipt as a record of posting. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは切手を購入した記録です。手紙を差し出した方法は何でしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is a record of purchasing stamps. How did you post the letter?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 近くのポストへ入れました。窓口で手紙を渡したわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 手紙は窓口でなくポストへ入れたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I put it into a nearby postbox. I did not hand the letter over at the counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you put the letter in a postbox rather than handing it over at the counter. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 切手の購入記録に、その手紙の宛先や引受記録は載っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: The stamp purchase record does not show that letter's destination or a record of its acceptance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そうですね。受取人からまだ届かないと聞き、このレシートを送付の証明として見せてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受取人へ購入記録を送付証明として見せたと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: That's true. The recipient said it had not arrived yet, and I showed them this receipt as proof that I sent it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you showed the purchase record to the recipient as proof of posting. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 購入と差出しの記録が別であると、受取人にもお伝えください。問い合わせには分かる範囲の情報を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also tell the recipient that purchase and posting records are separate. For the inquiry, we will ask for whatever information you know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。入れたポストは覚えていますが、時刻は夕方としか言えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 投函場所と時刻の記憶の精度を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I remember which postbox I used, but I can only say that the time was in the evening.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Indicate where you posted it and how precise your memory of the time is. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 宛先、差し出した日、封筒の特徴も分かれば教えてください。調べられる範囲をご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also tell us the destination, posting date, and envelope features if you know them. We will explain what we can investigate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: メモに整理します。切手のレシートで差出しを確認済みとは言わず、分かる情報で相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 購入証明と差出事実を区別し照会情報を整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will organize it in notes. I will not say that the stamp receipt confirms posting; I will discuss it using the information I know.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish proof of purchase from the fact of posting and organize information for the inquiry. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらでお問い合わせの方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We will explain how to make an inquiry here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご相談の引落しはどちらの会社ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which company's debit would you like to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: スポーツジムです。銀行で引落しを止めれば、会員契約も終わりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 引落停止で会員契約も終わるか質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: A gym. If I stop the automatic debit at the bank, will my membership contract end too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether stopping automatic debits also ends the membership contract. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 銀行での処理とジムの契約は別です。解約の申込みは済んでいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: The bank's procedures and the gym contract are separate. Have you already applied to cancel the contract?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。通わなくなったので、支払いだけ止めればよいと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 契約先へ未解約だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I stopped going, so I thought I only needed to stop paying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not canceled with the contracting company. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 先に契約先へ条件を確認してください。ここで引落しを止めても、契約上の請求がなくなるとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the conditions with the company first. Even if you stop the debit here, that does not necessarily eliminate charges under the contract.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。ジムへ解約時期と最後の請求を聞きます。銀行では今日の相談だけにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 解約時期と最終請求を先に聞くと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I will ask the gym about the cancellation date and final charge. Today I will only ask for information at the bank.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide to ask about the cancellation date and final charge first. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。口座に表示された会社名も、契約先と一致するか確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Certainly. Let us also check whether the company name shown on your account matches the contracting company.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この名前です。店名とは違うので、ジムへその名前も伝えて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 口座表示名と店舗名の違いを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is this name. It differs from the gym's name, so I will also give the gym that name and check.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Point out the difference between the name displayed on the account and the shop name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認結果をもとに、必要な口座手続きをご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Based on what you confirm, please discuss any necessary account procedures with us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。契約の終了を相手に確認してから、銀行で必要な処理を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 契約確認後に銀行処理を相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. After confirming the contract's termination with the company, I will ask the bank about any necessary steps.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will discuss bank procedures after checking the contract. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 本日は停止の手続きは行っていません。ご確認後にお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have not processed a stoppage today. Please return after checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 同じ商品を六つお求めですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like six of the same product, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。棚の奥から取れば全部新しいと思いましたが、一つだけ期限が違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 奥の商品でも期限が違うと知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I thought they would all be fresh if I took them from the back of the shelf, but one has a different expiry date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that even an item from the back has a different expiry date. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 商品の場所だけでは期限は分かりません。一つずつ表示をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The item's position alone does not tell you its expiry date. Please check the label on each one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この二つは明日まで、ほかは来週までです。六つを一週間で使う予定でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 各期限と一週間の使用予定を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: These two expire tomorrow, and the others next week. I was planning to use all six over a week.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the different expiry dates and your plan to use them over a week. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 使用予定に合わせてお選びください。違う期限の商品を一緒に買うこともできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please choose according to when you plan to use them. You can also buy items with different expiry dates together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 明日までに使えるのは一つだけです。もう一つは戻したいので、正しい棚を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 使い切れない一つの返却場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can only use one by tomorrow. I would like to put the other one back, so please show me the correct shelf.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask where to return the one item you cannot use in time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの同じ商品の棚です。冷蔵品なのでお戻しが難しければお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: It is this shelf for the same product. Since it is refrigerated, I can take it if putting it back is difficult.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では一つお願いします。残り五つも、一つずつ期限を確かめてから買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 返却を任せ残りを個別確認すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then please take one. I will also check the expiry date of each of the remaining five before buying them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will leave the return to the staff member and check the rest individually. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。外袋が似ている別の商品もありますので、名称もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. There are also different products with similar outer packaging, so please check their names too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 五つとも名称と期限を見ました。使う順番を分けて、この五つを買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 名称と期限を照合した購入数を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have checked the names and expiry dates on all five. I will plan the order of use and buy these five.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide how many to buy after checking names and expiry dates. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらをお会計します。戻す一つはお預かりしました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12232-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will ring these up. I have taken the one being returned.
